entities.summary: Walker Dwayne Russell Jr. is an American former professional basketball point guard. A native of Pontiac, Michigan, he played college basketball for Chipola College and Jacksonville State University. He currently serves as an assistant coach for the Motor City Cruise of the NBA G League.
